name: Animal Army Hospital
addressFull: 90/55 Moo 5, Na Jomtien, Sattahip, Chon Buri 20250, Thailand
hours: Daily 08:00-17:00; intake by appointment except critical emergencies

pricing.neutering: Dogs THB 1,200 male or female; cats THB 800 male or THB 1,000 female

emergency.notes: The hospital directly publishes 08:00-17:00 daily and appointment-only intake except critical emergencies. Its rescue service responds seven days a week in Chonburi with field assessment, first aid and transport, but no overnight coverage is stated. The published ambulance call-out fee is THB 1,000 as of 2026-07-20 (pricing.priceSourceUrl). This is a rescue/transport service, not a published routine house-call consultation service.

petTravel.notes: The official price page confirms microchipping, but does not identify the chip as ISO 11784/11785. No international health-certificate, rabies-titre, destination-laboratory, DLD accreditation, or export-paperwork service was found.
